verdict.rationale: Together AI documents a first-party `tg` CLI used across several workflows: launching fine-tuning jobs (docs-17), deploying dedicated endpoints with `tg beta endpoints deploy` (docs-25), and submitting batch jobs with `tg batches submit` (docs-45). That clearly delivers an official CLI. missing for 10: a dedicated CLI reference or installation page in the evidence, evidence of agent-friendly CLI behaviors (machine-readable output, non-interactive auth), the endpoints command being beta, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
